wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Leadership Edge Live LMS project overview. Explain the project's purpose as a cross-platform Learning Management System built with Flutter, its target audience of educational institutions and learners, and key features including multi-platform support (mobile, desktop, web), course management, progress tracking, offline learning capabilities, and gamification features. # Leadership Edge Live - Learning Management System

## Project Introduction

**Leadership Edge Live** is a comprehensive mobile learning platform built with Flutter, designed to provide an immersive educational experience across multiple platforms including iOS, Android, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux. The application focuses on delivering structured learning paths, course management, and progress tracking for professional development and skill enhancement.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- Deliver cross-platform mobile learning experiences
- Provide comprehensive course management and tracking
- Support multimedia content delivery (videos, PDFs, interactive content)
- Enable offline learning capabilities with intelligent caching
- Maintain consistent user experience across all supported platforms

### Target Audience
- Corporate training programs
- Professional development courses
- Educational institutions
- Skill-based learning organizations

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modular architecture pattern using Flutter Modular for dependency injection and routing, combined with Riverpod for state management. The system is designed with clear separation of concerns and feature-based organization.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Main App] --> B[Modular Router]
    B --> C[Authentication Module]
    B --> D[Courses Module]
    B --> E[Dashboard Module]
    
    C --> F[Auth Repository]
    D --> G[Course Repository]
    D --> H[Content Manager]
    E --> I[Progress Tracker]
    
    F --> J[(Local Storage)]
    G --> K[(API Layer)]
    H --> L[Media Player]
    H --> M[PDF Viewer]
    
    style A fill:#e1f5fe
    style B fill:#f3e5f5
    style C fill:#fff3e0
    style D fill:#e8f5e8
    style E fill:#fce4ec
```

### Design Patterns
- **Modular Architecture**: Feature-based modules with clear boundaries
- **Repository Pattern**: Data abstraction layer for API and local storage
- **MVVM Pattern**: Clean separation between views, view models, and business logic
- **Provider Pattern**: State management using Riverpod for reactive UI updates

### System Relationships
The application maintains loose coupling between features through well-defined interfaces and dependency injection. Each module encapsulates its own routes, dependencies, and business logic while sharing common core services.

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Application Bootstrap**: `lib/main.dart` - Initializes media kit, localization, and modular routing
- **Module Configuration**: `lib/app_module.dart` - Defines root routes and module registration
- **Feature Modules**: Organized under `lib/app/features/` with authentication, courses, dashboard, payment, and startup modules

### Core Modules Structure
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[App Core] --> B[Data Layer]
    A --> C[Design System]
    A --> D[Localization]
    A --> E[Logic Layer]
    A --> F[Models]
    A --> G[Providers]
    A --> H[Utils]
    A --> I[Views]
    
    B --> J[Repositories]
    E --> K[View Models]
    F --> L[Data Models]
```

### Configuration Approach
- **Environment Configuration**: `pubspec.yaml` manages all dependencies and build configurations
- **Platform-Specific Configurations**: Separate configurations for Android (`android/`), iOS (`ios/`), and other platforms
- **Asset Management**: Centralized asset organization under `assets/` for images and translations

### External Dependencies
Key dependencies include:
- **State Management**: `flutter_riverpod` for reactive state management
- **Routing & DI**: `flutter_modular` for modular architecture and dependency injection
- **HTTP Client**: `dio` for network requests with caching support
- **Local Storage**: `hive_flutter` for efficient local data persistence
- **Media Handling**: `media_kit` for cross-platform video playback
- **PDF Viewing**: `pdfrx` for document viewing capabilities
- **Localization**: `easy_localization` for multi-language support

### Integration Points
- **API Layer**: RESTful API integration through Dio client with interceptors
- **Media Services**: Video and PDF content streaming and caching
- **File Management**: Secure file handling for protected content
- **Platform APIs**: Native device features like camera, file picker, and system navigation

### Component Relationships
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Startup
    Startup --> Authentication: Check Session
    Authentication --> Dashboard: Valid User
    Authentication --> Login: Invalid Session
    
    Login --> Authentication: Sign In
    Dashboard --> Courses: Browse
    Dashboard --> Progress: Track
    Courses --> CourseDetail: Select Course
    CourseDetail --> ContentPlayer: Start Learning
    ContentPlayer --> Dashboard: Complete
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview
The Learning Management System provides comprehensive educational capabilities including:

- **Multi-Platform Support**: Seamless experience across mobile and desktop platforms
- **Course Management**: Complete course lifecycle from enrollment to completion
- **Content Delivery**: Support for videos, PDFs, and interactive learning materials
- **Progress Tracking**: Detailed analytics and progress monitoring
- **Offline Access**: Intelligent caching for uninterrupted learning
- **User Authentication**: Secure login and session management
- **Gamification**: Badges, points, and achievement systems

### Implementation Highlights

#### Authentication System
- **Secure Login**: Email/password authentication with session management
- **State Persistence**: Local storage for user preferences and credentials
- **Form Validation**: Real-time input validation with user feedback

#### Course Management
- **Course Catalog**: Browseable course listings with filtering and search
- **Enrollment System**: Course registration and access control
- **Progress Tracking**: Detailed progress monitoring per course
- **Completion Tracking**: Achievement and certification management

#### Content Delivery
- **Video Streaming**: Adaptive streaming with quality selection
- **PDF Viewing**: In-app document viewer with bookmarking
- **File Caching**: Intelligent offline content availability
- **Media Controls**: Playback controls and progress tracking

#### User Experience
- **Responsive Design**: Optimized layouts for different screen sizes
- **Theme Support**: Light/dark mode with custom branding
- **Localization**: Multi-language support with RTL capability
- **Accessibility**: Screen reader and keyboard navigation support

### Feature Architecture
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Interface] --> B[State Management]
    B --> C[Business Logic]
    C --> D[Data Layer]
    D --> E[External Services]
    
    A --> F[Navigation]
    F --> G[Route Guards]
    G --> H[Feature Modules]
    
    H --> I[Authentication]
    H --> J[Courses]
    H --> K[Dashboard]
    
    I --> L[Auth Service]
    J --> M[Course Service]
    K --> N[Analytics Service]
    
    style A fill:#e3f2fd
    style B fill:#f1f8e9
    style C fill:#fff8e1
    style D fill:#fce4ec
    style E fill:#f3e5f5
```

The application demonstrates a well-architected approach to building a scalable learning management system with modern Flutter best practices, providing a solid foundation for educational technology solutions.

</blog>
